name: Akei Yurika
source:
"Well, there are things best left unknown, right?"

A woman who helped to set up an inn in a seaport town. Lily is an amicable person who smiles all the time, but it is somewhat hard to figure out what she actually thinks.

She is the inn's head chef, but the inn is always so deserted that she also works as a librarian at the library adjacent to the inn.

[From [url=http://fruitbatfactory.com/seabed/]Fruitbat Factory[/url]]
